lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [excited, building] And just like that... the whole world switched to Robux.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: The bus wanted Robux. The cafeteria wanted Robux. Even the ice cream truck had a Robux price tag.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [disbelief] And then... everything got GAME PASSES.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: [chirpy] Supermarket VIP! Double cart speed! Ninety-nine Robux!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [fast, like a sports commentator] Want the short checkout line? Game pass. Want extra fries? Game pass. Want to skip math class?

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: [chirpy] Skip Math! Nine hundred ninety-nine Robux!

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.text: [gasps] I would literally sell my shoe for that.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [fast] The elevator had a "skip floors" pass. The dentist sold a "no drill" pass. My teacher sold a "delete homework" button.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [mock-horror] And Mom found a game pass called "free shipping." [pause] She bought it. For EVERYTHING.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.text: [satisfied] Even the groceries come by drone now.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [tired] My boss pays me in Robux now. And the coffee machine is a PREMIUM game pass.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [outraged] And a promotion costs five thousand Robux! It's a "Manager" rank!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [mysterious, lower voice] And every time anyone paid for anything... HE showed up.

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [nasal, fast, gleeful] Marketplace fee! Thirty percent! Thank you, come again!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: Nobody knew where he came from. Nobody knew where he went. He just... took thirty percent.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [outraged] He took thirty percent of my SANDWICH!
